network.notice: This plugin is network activated. Each site in the network connects to Readiness Index on its own, and activating it one site at a time is supported.
privacy.policy: This site uses the Readiness Index plugin. When an administrator connects it, the plugin sends this site's address, the versions of the plugin and WordPress, and a connection key to readinessindex.io, operated by TEN7, so the service can scan the site and return its score. The plugin adds nothing to this site's pages and sends no information about visitors or users. It collects no analytics. The plugin also answers a request for a small ownership file at /.well-known/readinessindex-verify, which the service reads to confirm the site is its owner's. The upgrade link and the link to the full report open readinessindex.io in the administrator's browser. Terms and privacy policy: https://readinessindex.io/terms and https://readinessindex.io/privacy.
